title: Frances Mary Peard
dates: (1835-1923)
---

member of the Gosling Society, novelist, contributor to MP (1866-85) and to the Monthly Paper of Sunday Teaching

She was a Gosling as ‘Fernseed’ from about 1865. She was the daughter of Captain Peard, RN, and lived at Sparnow, Torquay. She was sister of Charlotte (Peard) Kekewich. [Harris, F. M. Peard]
